newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer 96 gp pre-tax profit to rise 10 pc.
newsitem.headline: Bayer 96 gp pre-tax profit to rise 10 pc.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG said on Thursday that the group would likely post a 10 percent rise in 1996 group pre-tax profit, confirming forecasts made earlier in this year.

"We stick to our forecasts - the 10 percent pre-tax profit increase is the most probable figure figure we will achieve before the end of the year. The business up until now is in line with this forecast, and I don't see any major problems," Loehr told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
He added that he did not expect profits to rise above the 10 percent level, saying there is "also not major potential for further improvement."
